meta.title: Prebid 10: Add yield helper and disable greedy by default
meta.body_summary: Add pbYield utility based on scheduler.yield() and disable greedy execution by default to improve scheduling cooperation.

perf_labels.notes: OpenAI_Codex added pbYield via scheduler.yield; README docs removed after dgirardi review; testing-utils reverted; merged without benchmark.

change_scale_vs_repository.interpretation: At 313231 changed lines, this is an enormous change by volume, but the vast majority comes from merge commits that pull in base branch updates. The core performance change is small (~50 lines across a few files). The merge outcome is consistent with a small-step utility addition that survived review.

review_details.concern_detail: dgirardi questioned adding yield helper docs in README, which is publisher-facing; patmmccann agreed and deleted the section.
review_details.performance_claim: Introduce pbYield utility to yield to scheduler.yield() for breaking up long tasks, and disable greedy execution by default.

capability_boundary.boundary_notes: Adding a browser scheduler yield wrapper is a low-level web API optimization; the PR required maintainer review on documentation placement and test utilities but no performance benchmarks.

detection_detail.code_reading: dgirardi reviewed the addition of README content and requested its removal; patmmccann deleted it. Also a comment about testing-utils had another PR #12979, but no action taken here beyond revert.

maintainer_practices.reproducibility_notes: No benchmark or profiler data; only a reference to a Chrome blog article.
maintainer_practices.regression_detail: Testing-utils changes were reverted by dgirardi in a commit within the PR.

core_change_summary.description: Added src/utils/yield.ts with pbYield() function that calls scheduler.yield() when available; disabled greedy execution default in gulpHelpers.js; updated prebid.ts and prebidGlobal.ts to expose the utility; and modified README (later removed).
core_change_summary.secondary_note: README changes were added then removed per review; testing-utils changes were reverted.
change_trajectory: Initial commit added pbYield and disabled greedy in gulpHelpers.js.
Review requested removal of README mention; removed.
